delay_model.reader_rule: commands executed between `[tdelay <slot> <time> ...]` and the matching `[delayEnd]` (tag scan via GetNextDelayEnd) run in parallel; a reader should: execute the following commands immediately, keep a timer of <time> seconds (per slot), and continue blocking only when the delay expires or a blocking command (wait/message) appears. DelayStop/delayStopAll cancel the timer. checkTextSpeed multiplies delta by the text-speed ratio, so at fast play delays progress at text speed.

per_command_timing: Blocking commands (wait for user/next): message/talk commands, wait, select, wipe/fade with duration? (no - they register tween complete callbacks and the dispatcher continues only when handler returned false).

Timed commands (tween-based, non blocking): fade/wipe/flash/stretch/camera tweens store a <method> callback name (EndExecuteXxx) executed on tween end; a reader can just schedule them at t0 with the given duration.
Delayed commands (tdelay blocks): execute subsequent commands in parallel for <time> s.
renderer_guidance.color_model: Colors are Color(r,g,b,a) floats; fadeColor stored 0x5F0..0x5FC; flash has two colors and two durations.
